codeReview.summary: The consolidation of six small WebSocket helper modules into ws/lifecycle.py is clean, complete, and preserves all existing behavior. The deleted modules (startup_status.py, task_control.py, loop_exit.py, worker_request.py, failures.py, execution_support.py) are fully accounted for in lifecycle.py with clear sectional organization. Imports are updated correctly across all consumers (endpoint.py, stream.py, errors.py, artifacts.py, chat_persistence.py) and test files. All WS unit tests pass. WebSocket route registration remains intact.

issues.description: Functions build_execution_event and map_execution_step_type in lifecycle.py appear to have no external callers after consolidation. chat_persistence.py maintains its own local _build_execution_event and _map_execution_step_type variants.
